question.text: For a SAA with 60% equity target, the source illustrates threshold-based rebalancing using trigger points at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Threshold-based rebalancing works by setting trigger points/tolerance levels around the SAA. The workbook illustrates this with a 60% equity target and trigger points at 50% and 70%, so rebalancing is initiated only when the equity weight breaches that corridor. The Trap: A ±0.5% band would generate excessive trading costs and is not what the source uses; "no drift allowed" is operationally infeasible. Note: The trigger points/tolerance band must be set in advance — the specific numbers depend on the IPS, not on a universal rule.
